observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 161.» (L24) in the left margin.
body L6, L26, L33: the letters of the references (a), (b) and (c) are bold italic; with chapter 44 the letters begin again at a.
body L31-L33: the words from «Si hoc» to «docuimus» and «ita calculus verior fit» are italic; «[cap. XXXIX];» between them is in the roman type.
body L16, L22, L34: specks stand over the a of «Postea», over the first t of «latitudo» and over the r of «deprehende»; they are not accents.
body L22, L23: the l of the first «Sol» on L22 is printed broken, and the o of «Sol» on L23 thin, like a u.
notes_left L9: القمر (al-qamar, the Moon) is to be read in the Arabic text in place of الشمس (ash-shams, the Sun).
notes_right L9: Plato's value is printed «3′ 58″»; kept as printed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
